outcome: Developmental delay (gross motor skills, fine motor skills, language)
cohort: A 27-year-old woman with developmental delay and intractable epilepsy, diagnosed with cerebral folate deficiency.
finding: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with cerebral folate deficiency, developmental delay, and intractable epilepsy, who was born via cesarean section.
mod_finding: The patient was born via cesarean section.
